_about: Adult entry ages for catalogue health plans, with where each value came from. Built 2026-11-03. Only 19 of 203 policy wordings in the corpus state an adult entry age; the rest of this table covers the 17 plans named for an age group (youth or senior), read from the insurer's prospectus or brochure, or from a secondary source when the insurer's own document could not be read. adult_max null means no upper limit stated or a limit that differs by variant (see note). scripts/ops/apply_entry_ages.mjs writes this into backend/catalog_seed/*.json as profile.entry_age and prints the matching SQL for the live catalogue.
